messages:
evelyn: heads-up: we got a customer ticket from Acme about intermittent KMS 403s on private cluster after last night's RBAC rollout. degradation ~2-3% of decrypts. anyone oncall?

ben: that was rollout-5883 (keystore RBAC cleanup). I applied rolebinding changes across priv-keystore namespaces. nothing obvious in the CI logs but will look.

tom: paste of audit sample from priv-keystore-prod: ```
2026-03-24T03:12:03Z keystore-proxy[pod-x] WARN audit_id=73f2 path=/v1/decrypt status=403 principal=svcacc:model-serving@priv-keystore reason=rbac:missing-binding
```

qa-jen: quick note: our RBAC smoke on staging uses svcacc:canary-runner in infra-tests which has a ClusterRoleBinding. our canary didn't exercise the exact prod principal — that's a test-gap. :grimace:

ben: ohhh. we accidentally used ClusterRoleBinding in tests only. the patch I applied created a RoleBinding (namespaced) but the intended principal is cluster-scoped svcaccs created by the deployment controller. mismatch between test and prod.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout-5883 keystore-rbac v1.4 applied by @ben at 2026-03-24T02:45:10Z commit: 9a7b3c

infra-monitor: network telemetry looks clean; TCP/TLS handshakes to kms.internal succeed, no conntrack evictions. latency spike small. so this is auth, not netpol.

acme-sre: Acme sees degraded inference in a subset of hosts (node-pool B). They requested a rollback option.

evelyn: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) create a narrow ClusterRoleBinding granting kms:Decrypt to svcacc:model-serving (temp, 1hr) 2) update RBAC manifest to correctly bind the existing cluster-scoped svcaccs 3) add rbactest to CI that impersonates real prod principals

ben: I can apply a temporary CRB now. command: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata: {name: keystore-temp-allow-model-serving}
subjects: [{kind: ServiceAccount, name: model-serving, namespace: priv-keystore}]
roleRef: {kind: ClusterRole, name: keystore-decrypt-temporary, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io}
EOF
```

ben: then I'll correct the rollout manifest and reapply.

qa-jen: long-term tests: add a matrix so canary runs as the exact svcaccs the daemonset uses (model-serving, sidecar-proxy). Also add a preflight that verifies `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:priv-keystore:model-serving decrypt secrets/kms-key` or similar.

tom: postmortem items: - add deploy metadata (deploy_id, commit, actor) to keystore audit events - enforce RBAC preflight in CI with real principals - shrink canary privileges (avoid cluster-binding in tests) - add alert for abnormal 403% in keystore-proxy (threshold 0.5% over 5m)

infra-monitor: increased keystore audit retention +48h and enabled high-fidelity debug for one hour for the affected namespaces.

ben: applied the temporary CRB at 03:25 UTC. watching.

acme-sre: confirmed error rate falling back to baseline after temporary CRB. thanks.

evelyn: for documentation: we should add a private-deploy runbook section `RBAC rollout checklist` with steps: smoke principals list, preflight auth checks, audit link, rollback command, customer notify. I'll create RFC-priv-rbac and assign owners.

ben: I'll open INC-20260324-B and link the commit and diffs. also will remove the temporary CRB after 1 hour.

qa-jen: follow-up ticket for QA: QA-PRIV-117 add matrixed canary across namespaces & principals.

evelyn: good work. keeping this thread for the post-incident notes. tagging @oncall-sre for visibility. :white_check_mark:
